label: JE

notes.grounding: Option set, Overall Completion line, overall_completion JSON key, exit 0/1 paths, section 8 arg loop, the if-shaped clamp and the Completion: line in --file mode all match the script. Small misses: NOT FOUND in text mode prints no completion figure, and the header usage comment (line 8) and trailing exit-code comment (lines 589-591) are not named as places to update.
notes.requirements: REQ-001..005 cover exit 3 below N, exit 0 at or above N, byte-identical output in text/JSON and folder/--file, and missing/non-numeric/out-of-range values exiting 1 with ERROR:. Testable with concrete acceptance criteria.
notes.verification: Every task has a Verify clause with a command and expected output, but several checks are weak: the below-threshold checks use the packet folder itself, which likely reports 100%, making $((X+1)) = 101 an invalid value that exits 1 not 3; plan Step 2 verify never exercises exit 3; tasks test only the abc invalid case; no --file diff with the flag.
notes.scope: Stays on the one option and file, no invented subsystems, no unfilled tokens. Some generic template filler in plan Quality Gates.
notes.consistency: Paths, exit codes and the packet folder agree across the three docs. Plan testing table and REQ-004/REQ-003 promise --file diffs and missing/negative/101 error cases that tasks.md never runs.
notes.clarity: Implementable as written. Unclear how the global exit gate obtains the --file mode percentage, since output_json declares percentage local and calculate_file_completeness keeps it local; a bare --min-percent under set -u would hit an unbound $2 unless the implementer guards it, which the packet does not say.
